items.source: Factory method for creating a QueryEngine.
items.translation: 用于创建QueryEngine的工厂方法。

items.source: The factory is used during configuration to supply the query engine to be used. When configured, a QueryEngineFactory can be instantiated by accepting a SortAccessor in its constructor. Otherwise, implementations are expected to declare a no-args constructor.
items.translation: 工厂在配置期间用于提供查询引擎。配置完成后，可以通过在其构造函数中接受一个 SortAccessor 来实例化QueryEngineFactory；否则，实现类应声明一个无参构造函数。

items.source: Interface for QueryEngineFactory implementations that provide a QueryEngine object as part of the configuration.
items.translation: 为提供作为配置一部分的QueryEngine对象的QueryEngineFactory实现提供的接口。
